sections.title: AI Services for Atlanta Healthcare Organizations
sections.description: Production AI solutions for Atlanta's world-class healthcare ecosystem.

blocks.heading: Clinical AI for Atlanta Health Systems
paragraphs: Emory Healthcare, Piedmont Healthcare, and Northside Hospital:

Patient risk stratification: 30-day readmission prediction, clinical deterioration early warning, and length of stay prediction for Atlanta's large academic and community health systems — with Epic FHIR R4 integration (Emory and Piedmont both use Epic as their primary EHR).
Ambient clinical documentation: LLM converting physician-patient conversations to structured clinical notes, reducing documentation burden for Atlanta's large clinical workforce.
Surgical and procedural scheduling optimization: ML for OR scheduling efficiency and case length prediction for Atlanta's high-volume surgical programs.
Cost: $55,000–$140,000 | Timeline: 14–24 weeks | HIPAA + Georgia privacy

blocks.heading: Pediatric Healthcare AI
paragraphs: Children's Healthcare of Atlanta (CHOA, consistently ranked among the US's top pediatric hospitals) creates specific pediatric AI requirements distinct from adult health system AI:

Pediatric clinical decision support: AI for pediatric dosing, weight-based medication calculations, and age-specific clinical guideline application — where general adult clinical AI requires specific pediatric calibration.
Pediatric population health: ML for pediatric chronic disease management (asthma, obesity, type 1 diabetes) across CHOA's large Georgia patient population.
Rare disease identification: NLP identifying potential rare disease diagnoses from clinical documentation for CHOA's rare disease clinical programs.
Cost: $60,000–$150,000 | Timeline: 14–26 weeks | HIPAA + COPPA (pediatric context)

blocks.heading: Digital Health and HealthTech
paragraphs: Atlanta's digital health startup community — backed by Georgia Tech's Health Systems Institute, the Marcus Foundation's health investments, and general Atlanta venture capital:
Remote patient monitoring AI for Atlanta digital health companies serving the Southeast.
Telehealth platform AI for Atlanta's telemedicine community.
Healthcare SaaS product AI for the enterprise health technology companies Atlanta attracts.
Cost: $45,000–$150,000 | Timeline: 12–28 weeks | HIPAA + FDA SaMD awareness

blocks.heading: Georgia Medicaid and Public Health
paragraphs: Georgia's Medicaid program (Georgia Medicaid, managed primarily through DCH — Department of Community Health) and Atlanta's public health community:
Georgia Medicaid population health analytics for Atlanta's managed care organizations serving Georgia Medicaid.
Disease surveillance and epidemiology analytics for Georgia DPH (Department of Public Health).
Social determinants of health ML for Atlanta's complex urban/rural Georgia population.
Cost: $50,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | Georgia DCH context

blocks.heading: Georgia Patient's First Act
paragraphs: Georgia's telemedicine legislation and patient-first care requirements affect how clinical AI tools are deployed in Georgia telehealth contexts.

blocks.heading: Georgia DPH health data
paragraphs: Georgia's Department of Public Health data governance requirements apply to population health AI using Georgia public health datasets.

blocks.heading: Grady Memorial Hospital context
paragraphs: Grady Health System (Atlanta, funded by Fulton and DeKalb counties) serves a disproportionately low-income and uninsured patient population — public hospital AI must be designed with equity and access in mind alongside clinical effectiveness.

blocks.heading: Emory's IRB and research governance
paragraphs: Emory's clinical research programs have specific IRB and data governance requirements for research AI — ClickMasters designs Emory research AI within Emory's IRB frameworks.
